purpose: Screen the Cagayan Riverine Zone plan's main river and named major tributaries against the already extracted Region II GeoNames hydrography point queue.

searchMethod.nameRule: Case/diacritic/punctuation-normalized whole-label equality after removing generic river/creek/stream terms; primary and alternate labels are distinguished.
searchMethod.componentRule: The source composite Siffu-Mallig is also screened as two separate component names; component hits are not counted as a match to the composite name.
searchMethod.specificBranchRule: Names beginning with Pinacanauan plus another specific locality term are reported as related-name candidates, not exact matches.
searchMethod.provinceContext: Retained as a source point-overlay label for triage; no expected-province conflict is inferred because the planning text does not assign a province to each river lead.

Siffu-Mallig.interpretation: Component labels are separate discovery leads; this does not resolve whether the source composite denotes one river system or linked rivers.

Pinacanauan.interpretation: Specific locality-qualified labels are kept separate; point gazetteer names do not establish whether they are branches, reaches, or distinct rivers.

limitations: The planning source is a 2005-2030 regional framework, not a current hydrographic inventory or fish survey.
GeoNames feature-H points and labels are heterogeneous gazetteer candidates, not river centerlines, basin boundaries, verified tributary topology, or current waterbody conditions.
A normalized name or alternate label may refer to a settlement, reach, branch, historical name, or ambiguous feature; no identity or hydrologic connection is confirmed.
No per-river expected province was established from the plan, so overlay province labels are context only and are not conflict findings.
A missing candidate is not evidence that a river is absent; the candidate list excludes unresolved points outside one land-province polygon and has uneven source coverage.
No fish occurrence, habitat, access, salinity, legal, safety, or public-app claim is made.
